content: Petulu na Yohana bhapelakeka palongi ja pachengo
Petulu na Yohana pabhakabhi bhakali kubhatangazi bhandu, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa, chiongozi wa manjolinjoli wa Nyumba jaka Chapanga, papamu na Masadukayo bhakumu bhakabhahikile.
Bhakayomiki namaa ndandi mitumi bhaka Yesu habha bhabhatangazya bhandu kubha Yesu akayokiki kuhuma kwa bhakuwa, chihengu chechilangia hotuhotu kubha bhandu bhabhapotili anabhayokaje.
Henu bhakabhakamwi Petulu na Yohana na ndandi ikilu ukaheghalile, bhakabhabhei muchifungo mbaka chilabhu jaki.
Nambu bhandu bhamaheli bhabhakajowini malobhi ghaka Petulu na Yohana bhakahobhalile, kwa kubhalangika bhakabhi ngati akanalomi elufu nhwano.
Chilabhu jaki ihongozi bha Bhayahude, bhazee, na bhabhola bha Shelia bhakahimangini papamu ku Yelusalemu.
Bhakahimangini papamu na Anasi Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa, Kayafa, Yohana, Alekizanda, na bhandu bhangi bhalongu bhaka Mpenganyambiku Nkolongwa.
Pabhakabhajemiki Petulu na Yohana pachilanda jabhu, bhakabhalalukile, “Bho, mabhanganya muhengiki lijambu lendenu kwa makili bholi na kwa lihina laka nane?”
Panihapa Petulu akabya atwelakiki Roho Mhuhu, akabhayangike, “Ihongozi na bhazee bha bhandu bha Izilaeli,
anamutulaluki lalenu panani ja lijambu la wichu letunhengi mundu joakabhi atengwiki jola na moapati kubha mwome,

henu, imanyikana kwinu mabhanganya na bhandu bhokapi bha Izilaeli kubha, mundu jonjo alamiki nakanopi kwa makili na lihina laka Yesu Kristo wa ku Nazaleti, jomukunhwambiki mabhanganya punsalaba, nambu Chapanga akamuyohiki kuhuma kwa bhabhawile.
Ajoju nde joghakolabheka Malembu Mahuhu,

content.text: ‘Liganga lemulikaniki mwabhachenga, sajenu libhi liganga likolongwa la kunkeghe.’

content: Kabheti ukengaleku ngachekupatikana kwaka mundu jongi jokapi jola, maghambu pundema pokapi bhandu ngachebhapatiki lihina laka mundu jokapi jola leliweza kutukengalela twabhandu.”

Ihongozi bha pachengu pabhaweni ukangamalu waka Petulu na Yohana na kumanya kubha bhakabhi bhandu bha pahi na bhangakubha na malangu, bhakakangichi namaa, na bhakamanyiki kubha bhandu bhanihabha bhakabhi papamu na Yesu.
Bhela pabhakumbweni mundu joalamiswi ajemi papamu na Petulu na Yohana, ngachebhaweziki kulonge lilobhi lokapi lela la kubhapenga.
Bhakabhapwaghi bhapitaje mu chumba cha pachengu, bhombi bhakahighali mkati ja chumba bhakalongila bheni kwa bheni.
Bhakalaluwine, “Bho, tubhahenga kiki bhandu abhabha? Kila mundu joatama mu Yelusalemu amanyiki chakaka ngati ukangachu ghongo ukolongwa bhuhengike, na tepani ngatuwezi kupenga lijambu lenihele.
Nambu ngati anatupala kulihibhalaki lijambu lenu ngalijendale kwa bhandu bhamahele, tubhalakalya ngabhilonge na mundu jokapi jola kwa lihina laka Yesu.”
Bhakabhalohiki kabheti bhajingala mkati ja pachengu na bhakabhalakali ngabhilonge kabheti palanga, wala kubhabhola bhandu kwa lihina laka Yesu.
Nambu Petulu na Yohana bhakabhayangiki, “Muhaghula mabhanganya mabhete ngati wichu palongi jaka Chapanga kuntii mabhanganya kuliku kuntii Chapanga.
Nambu tepani ngatuwezi kukotoka kulonge mambu ghatughaweni na kughajowana.”
Bhakolongwa bha pachengu habha bhakabhajowihi kabheti nakanopi na kubhalekakela bhabhokaje. Ngachebhaweziki kubhalapula ndandi bhandu bhokapi bhundumbalya Chapanga kwa ndandi ja lijambu lenilela.
Mundu joakalamiswi jola akabhi na umule wa kupeta hyaka alobaini.
Bhahobhalela bhundobha Chapanga abhapekya makile
Palapala Petulu na Yohana, pabhakalekakiwi pela bhakakelawiki kwa bhajabho, na kubhapwaghi mambu ghabhapwaghiki bhakolongwa bha bhapenganyambiku na bhazee bha pachengu.
Bhandu habha pabhakajowini mambu ghanihagha bhakalibhongini papamu kundobha Chapanga, bhakapwaghaje, “Bambo, wehapa nde weubhombiki kunani kumahunde na ndema, nhwanga na yokapi yeibhi mkati jake!
Wehapa ukuntei mtumika waku, atati witu Daude, alongilaje kwa makili ghaka Roho Mhuhu, paapwaghikaje,

content.text: Bho, mbona makabila gha bhandu bhahengiki mipangu ja waka?
kulongalela panani jaka Bambo, na Kristo wake.’

content: Maghambu kwa chakaka Helode, Pontio Pilato, bhandu bha Izilaeli, na bhandu bha ku inchi nayengi bhakahimangani pa muchi pani, kumpenga Yesu, Mtumika waku Mhuhu, joukunjeghili mahuta.
Bhombi bhakahimangini nahuli bhahenga malobhi ghaughapalikaje na kupanga kutumbu pamwandi kwa uwezu na mapalu ghaku.
Nambu sajenu, Bambo, lingalyaje malakalilu ghabhu. Utujangatyaje tepani mitumi bhaku kutangaza lilobhi laku panga na choghohi.
Uhatambulaje chiwoku chaku nahuli ubhalamihaje bhatamwa. Na kuhenga nginyulila na ngangachu kwa lihina laka Mwana waku mhuhu Yesu.”
Pabhakajomwi kundobha Chapanga, pandu pabhakahimangini pala pakanyuwakiki, na bhokapi bhakatwelakiki Roho Mhuhu. Bhokapi bhakatumbwi kutangaza lilobhi laka Chapanga panga na choghohi.
Bhahobhalela bhaghabhana hindu yabhu

Bhahobhalela bhala bhokapi bhakabhi na mtima ghumu na roho jimu. Nga mundu hata jumu joakabhi na chindu chokapi chela akakibheka kubha chindu chaki mweni kanjika, nambu bhakajangatini kila chindu chebhakabhi nachu.
Mitumi bhakatangizi kwa makili ghamaheli kuhyoka kwaka Bambo Yesu na chihomu chamaheli chaka Chapanga chakabhi panani jabho.
Nga mundu nga jumu joakabhi panga chindu, maghambu pamaheli bhabhakabhi na mighonda au nyumba bhakailombise, na kuleta mbija yebhalombasile,
na kubhapeke mitumi mbija yene, nabhombi bhakaghabhini ngati kila mundu kulengana na moapalilaje.
Kukabhi na Mlawi jumu, mbelekeka wa ku Kipulo, lihina laki Yusufu, jobhundohika mitumi Banaba ndandi jaki, “Mundu wa kujeghe mtima,”
najombi akabhi na ngonda waki akaulombisi, na akatoliki mbija yeakapatiki na kubhapeke mitumi.
